newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary grain futures little changed in still mkt.
newsitem.headline: Hungary grain futures little changed in still mkt.

text.p: Grains futures prices on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) were little changed after Monday's trade in very modest turnover, dealers said.
"The market will only revive when producers sell their remaining stocks," said Antal Szoke of Agrimpex.
This is likely to happen within the next three weeks, he added, as producers will have to find the money to start springtime operations.
The meagre number of deals was due to sellers and buyers going in different directions, Szoke added.
"Sellers were trying to go up by (the maximum allowed 400 forints) limit, while buyers were attempting to go down by limit," he said.
The only sizeable number of 175 contracts changed hands for the March delivery maize which closed at 19,550 forints, down 50.
Total turnover was 130 million forints or 273 contracts.
Lot size is 20,000 kgs for all contracts.
